name: Death is Sunhaired
source:
You’re living in a 19th century village where no-one understands you, suddenly all your fellow men start dying and you are sent on a one-way quest to the lord’s castle.

[From [url=https://galengames.itch.io/death-is-sun]itch.io[/url]]

[来自[url=https://galengames.itch.io/death-is-sun]itch.io[/url]]
